name: llava-bench-in-the-wild-pt
description: A Portuguese in-the-wild multimodal benchmark that evaluates image+text (question) understanding for LLaVA-style models. It contains natural, real-world visual question prompts in Portuguese to test a model's visual grounding, comprehension and generation of open-ended answers. Intended to measure multilingual multimodal performance in unconstrained settings.
reputation: A community-contributed Portuguese multimodal test set with limited but growing use for evaluating Portuguese-capable vision-language models.
